status: V7 build visually inspected: scallion stalk lengths and root cuts no longer explode; gradients and staff surfaces rendered. Not photoreal acceptance.
change: Use SmoothStep(0,1,InverseLerp(edge0,edge1,value)), with versioned generated texture/mesh keys.
finding: Mathf.SmoothStep interpolates from a to b with t, unlike GLSL smoothstep(edge0,edge1,value). Existing threshold-like calls produced incorrect green transitions, wood/quartz flecks, acoustic pores and fish stripes.
additional_fix: Bound integer noise inputs before Perlin evaluation; validate scallion mesh bounds and finite coordinates during scene generation.
